result.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

scope: The 14 cleanup-supervisor cases pass under registered group leaders, preserving their generated diagnostics and failure controls. Three obsolete fixed-port failure expectations are replaced by actual custody/content/journal worker cases that succeed on ephemeral loopback ports while the former ports remain occupied; each verifies clean server and process closure. Storage-properties retains its real fixed-port failure assertion and borrows owned Chromium to reach it. All four 25-second case bounds remain, with a 120-second file bound. The first stale-expectation run and a subsequent browser-identity refusal are retained. The group owner writes an intent before launch, publishes the leader before payload execution, prevents late payload start after closure and separately binds the actual worker PID for custody. Unknown registration or failed closure storage cannot prove drain. All 50 final ownership controls pass: 31 stage, five Vitest and fourteen native, including abrupt death, TERM resistance, late launch and closure-marker failure. This is cooperative ownership for reviewed tests, not hostile-code confinement. The other Node group is complete: nine files / 39 cases. Full campaign output retention, production old-writer exclusion and immutable qualification remain separate.
